description: Starts a run: everything one job creates, grouped in your account. The run comes with its own isolated private network (internet access, no route to your other networks; its id is network_id in the result). The run's machines are empty VMs: send_signals with empty_vm: true, through the redu MCP with the run's key (create_run_key); the platform sizes each one from the signal and starts it in that network. Pass the run's id as run_id to create_volume and create_private_network; each resource joins the run. When the job is done, end_run deletes everything in the run, its network included, and checks each one gone. The network and the machines are billed as usual. network: false makes a run without a network of its own (it then cannot get machines). lease_minutes: the run ends by itself, everything in it deleted, when nothing renews it (renew_run) for that long; give one whenever a program drives the run, so a runner that dies never leaves billed machines behind.

budget.description: Optional: the run's budget in GBP (the account budget's currency). Once the run's spend reaches it, nothing new can join the run (soft) or the platform ends the run (hard). get_run shows what it has spent.

budget_mode.description: soft (the default): the run stops growing at its budget. hard: the platform ends the run and deletes everything in it. Only with budget.

lease_minutes.description: Optional, 5 to 10080 (7 days): the run's lease. The platform ends the run and deletes everything in it when nothing calls renew_run for this many minutes. Leave it out and the run lives until end_run.

name.description: Optional short name for the run, e.g. nightly-eval.

network.description: Default true: the run gets its own isolated private network, deleted with the run. false: no network of its own; put its machines on networks you already have.

name: create_run
title: Create run
